Thanks again for taking the time to interview Evan this morning. I pulled my notes and attached the raw write-up (evan_morales_interviewer_notes.docx). Quick summary from my side: product sense felt solid, but I have concerns about closer-coupled execution experience for a Staff-level PM.

My quick scores (out of 5):

- Execution: 3

Thanks all for the quick turn. I pulled the notes and the attached consolidated scorecard (consolidated-scorecard-irene.pdf) — below is the reconciled view and recommended next step.

Reconciled scores (avg, rounded):
- Product sense: 4.0
- Execution: 2.7 (rounded to 3 for Greenhouse workflow)
- Leadership/Influence: 3.7

Read: Strong product intuition, some risk on hands-on execution for a Staff-level role. The team is split but leans toward a "hold for now / require an execution-focused follow-up" instead of immediate hire.

Proposed next steps (please ack or raise objections by end of day tomorrow):
1) Ask candidate for a 45-minute "delivery deep-dive" with Priyom and a Platform Eng IC (Hannah, can you coordinate availability?) — template: candidate walks through one shipped project with artifacts and outcomes.
2) If delivery deep-dive satisfies Priyom/Platform Eng, proceed to hiring manager skip-level to validate org fit.
3) If not satisfied, provide targeted feedback and close loop; no off-cycle offer.

I will update Greenhouse with the reconciliation and attach the consolidated notes. Calendar draft for the delivery deep-dive: https://calendar.google.com/event?action=VIEW&eid=abcd1234efgh
Greenhouse record: https://greenhouse.io/candidate/evan-morales-12345

Thanks — please reply here if you disagree with the flow. If no objections, I'll notify Hannah to schedule the deep-dive and will move the candidate to "on hold - follow-up required" in Greenhouse.

Best,
Irene Choi
Hiring Manager (Product)
Redwood Inference
